title: Different defects need different controls
method: Synthetic 5,000-event input. Missing destination affects 50/5,000 = 1% of input events; the 30 join-generated rows use a different population. Values illustrate two fault locations and must not be treated as one defect rate.
alt: Different defects need different controls. Missing destination: 50 records; Extra joined rows: 30 records. Illustrative values.
